method: Recompute all six coefficients solely from source numerical properties and chosen native reference material/carrier, then reproduce native float32 and six-significant-digit RF serialization; no response used to choose coefficients.
scope: Linear static displacement and end-wrench equivalence under commercial-linear-static-v2. Literal material E/G, density/design properties and effective EA/EIy/EIz/GJ/GAsz/GAsy are distinguished.
precisionNotes: All RF coefficients exactly match independently predicted float32 then six-significant-digit decimal representation.

Section P tokens have mixed native decimal/scientific precision; actual token values are retained, not falsely called uniformly six significant digits. Native internally generated carrier parameters are read back, and resulting six-stiffness differences are disclosed separately.
No benchmark response tolerance is changed. Native values remain the same-engine reference values; matrix/OpenSees responses are independent diagnostic comparisons only.
